employees.title: Employees
employees.description: The staff list, contracts, work done and documents coming due.
employees.emptyBody: Add the first employee. The timesheet and payroll run from this list.
employees.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed from the list. An employee with records cannot be deleted: choose "Terminate" instead.
employees.terminatedNoLogin: Employee terminated. No login was linked, so nothing was blocked.
employees.terminateBody: Their login stops working at once. Everything they entered stays.
employees.terminateBodyNoLogin: No login is linked to this employee. If they have one, choose it below so that it stops too.
employees.pieceHint: Piece rates are paid on top of the base rate. Leave them empty if not needed.

fields.herdHint: The shepherd KPI and labour cost attach to this herd
fields.loginHint: When linked, the employee checks in and out themselves

workDone.description: Gathered automatically from the field and livestock journals.
workDone.emptyBody: Field operations, veterinary and daily records show up here.

reminders.emptyTitle: Nothing due in the next 60 days
reminders.emptyBody: Contract, medical check, leave and safety briefing dates appear here.

safety.title: Safety briefings
safety.emptyBody: Keep signed occupational safety briefings here.

timesheet.title: Timesheet
timesheet.description: Who was at work and when. The month's payroll is built on this.
timesheet.closed: Payroll for this month is approved, so the timesheet is closed.
timesheet.emptyBody: The timesheet appears once there are people on the staff list.

bulk.title: Fill the timesheet at once
bulk.description: Marks everyone for the chosen days. Days after today are not marked as present.
bulk.overwriteHint: When off, days marked earlier stay as they are

checkIn.title: Today's work
checkIn.notYet: You have not checked in today.
checkIn.sinceYesterday: Yesterday's shift is still open, started at {{time}}.
checkIn.finished: Today you worked from {{from}} to {{to}}: {{hours}} h.
checkIn.noLocation: Location unavailable, so this was saved without it.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.description: Each month's payroll is built from the timesheet and work done. Official tax records are kept in Keeping.
payroll.addBody: Calculated from the timesheet, work done, KPI rules and advances.
payroll.emptyBody: Once a month has ended, calculate its payroll.
payroll.recalculated: Recalculated. Amounts entered by hand were kept
payroll.approved: Approved, and labour cost posted to cost centers
payroll.approveBody: {{amount}} will be posted as labour cost. After this, the month's timesheet and amounts cannot change.
payroll.makerHint: You prepared this payroll, so someone else must approve it.
payroll.editedByHand: Changed by hand, kept on recalculation

notify.submitted: Payroll for {{month}} is waiting for approval

advances.addBody: Money leaves the account now and comes off this month's pay. A large amount goes for approval.
advances.emptyBody: Advances given during a month come off that month's pay automatically.

kpi.description: Bonuses are worked out every month: lamb survival for shepherds, hectares worked for mechanics.
kpi.emptyBody: Once a rule exists, its bonus goes into the payroll automatically.

reward.per_unit: For each unit above the threshold
